title: Incorrect EOF detection in _get_endmarker_and_dedents
detail: When a non-DEDENT leaf (e.g., a statement) follows the last ignored node before ENDMARKER, the function returns that leaf as the endmarker. The caller then treats it as an EOF node, stripping its prefix and potentially removing code comments or whitespace from a normal statement, which is incorrect and can corrupt the source.
note: Describes the planted flip: a leaf that isn't the end marker is returned as one.

title: Incorrect return when encountering ENDMARKER in _get_endmarker_and_dedents
detail: The function `_get_endmarker_and_dedents` is supposed to return the ENDMARKER leaf and any intervening DEDENT leaves. However, when the sibling is an ENDMARKER, it returns `(None, [])`, causing the caller to think no ENDMARKER was found and to drop trailing comments and blank lines in unclosed `# fmt: off` blocks.
note: The other half of the planted flip: the end marker itself gets `(None, [])`.

title: Incorrect logical operator in blank line condition
detail: The condition uses `or` which causes a blank line to be printed when either the console is non-interactive or not a Jupyter console. The intended behavior is to print only when both conditions are true, i.e., when the console is non-interactive and not a Jupyter console.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: The Twisted `DeferredLock` object exposes a `locked()` method, not a `locked` attribute. Accessing `self._export_lock.locked` will raise an `AttributeError`, causing the exporter to crash when an item is scraped.
note: `locked` is an attribute of DeferredLock; not about the dropped await.

title: Incorrect logic in accept_html property
detail: The property is documented to return True when `text/html` is accepted, but the code returns True when it is *not* present, causing callers to receive the opposite result.
